question: Which of the following regions has very humid climate?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sirohi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Sirohi** is located in the southwestern part of Rajasthan and is characterized by its proximity to the Aravalli Hills.
 
• The region experiences a **humid climate** due to its relatively higher elevation and vegetation compared to other parts of Rajasthan.
 
• Unlike arid regions such as Bikaner, Barmer, or Jaisalmer, Sirohi has better water availability, contributing to its humid conditions.
 
• The presence of forests and a more favorable geographical location makes Sirohi distinct in terms of climate compared to the desert regions of Rajasthan.
 
• Sirohi also receives relatively higher rainfall during the monsoon season compared to other regions of Rajasthan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Aravalli Range**

 
 
• The Aravalli Range is one of the oldest fold mountain ranges in India, running across Rajasthan, Haryana, and Gujarat.
 
• The range plays a crucial role in influencing the climate and vegetation of regions like Sirohi.
 
• It acts as a watershed, providing water resources to nearby areas and contributing to more humid conditions.
 
 
 
• **Desert Climate in Rajasthan**
 
 
• Regions like Bikaner, Barmer, and Jaisalmer are part of the Thar Desert, characterized by arid and dry conditions.
 
• These areas receive scanty rainfall and are known for extreme temperature variations.
 
• The lack of vegetation and water bodies results in a predominantly dry climate.
 
 
 
• **Humidity and Climatic Conditions**
 
 
• Humidity refers to the amount of water vapor present in the air.
 
• Regions with abundant vegetation, water bodies, and higher rainfall typically exhibit higher humidity levels.
 
• In Rajasthan, areas closer to the Aravalli Hills or with better vegetation tend to be more humid compared to desert areas.
 
 
 
• **Rainfall Patterns in Rajasthan**
 
 
• Rajasthan experiences a diverse range of rainfall patterns, from scanty rainfall in desert regions to moderate rainfall in areas like Sirohi.
 
• The southwestern part of Rajasthan, including Sirohi, benefits from the monsoon season, receiving more rainfall compared to arid regions.
 
• This contributes to the distinct climatic conditions observed across the state.
